svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Base: 200 x 900 plate, two 18 dia holes 40 from each end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Web: 840 wide x 597 high with a 833 dia curved cut in the top,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centred, its centre 800 above the floor

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Wear plate: 160 wide strip rolled to 813 inside dia over 120 deg

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld web to base on its centre line, square, both sides

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld the wear plate onto the web's curved top, centred

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Set both saddles on a level floor 950 apart and lower the shell

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in; the wear plates take the shell along their full arc

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fillet weld each wear plate to the shell along both edges

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: shell axis level and 800 above the floor at both ends
